digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criterion routing and decision kernel
propositions: G7 routing entry must flip from default_posture advisory/block_threshold 0.95 to blocking/0.85 to match historical FP findings (0 clearly-incorrect at >= 0.85 across 348 findings) and follow the bfa8/c97a precedent pattern.

Plan-review blocking derives only from default_posture == 'blocking' plus block_threshold via threshold_for(gate='plan_review'); kind scoping is already enforced by the existing plan-v4 divergence grading where contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor at 0.85 impact while incomplete_enumeration caps at 0.55.

G7 rubric must add four rules: FAIL-OPEN abstain-with-coverage for unresolvable parents, CLOSED-PARENT final-state checking plus sibling-handoff, DEDUP-AT-SOURCE one-finding-per-contradicted-clause, and explicit floor-kind guidance distinguishing contract contradictions from cosmetic mismatches.

Pinned test assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking'); new G7_BLOCKING constant added to blocking-set union in tests.

New tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py must verify blocking behavior through real orchestrator Pass-3 wrapper with real impact_plan for all three blocking-floor kinds at boundary conditions (priority >= 0.85) and validity guard.
docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must be regenerated via the registry regenerate-criteria-guide command and committed with no diff.
